不基于血缘关系，而是通过秘密仪式
任意结成社会团体，被称为秘密结社。
以前，在欧美曾出现很多以社交沙龙为中心
的秘密结社，给革命运动带来了深远的影响。
秘密结社大致可分为「政治的秘密结社」和
「行会的秘密结社」两种。

所谓政治的秘密结社，会隐瞒成员姓名和组织
活动，通常是对现存政治势力的反抗或是策划
阴谋。例如，意大利和法国的「烧炭党」、美国
的「3K党」以及俄罗斯的「布尔什维克党」等。

与此相对的，行会的秘密结社通常不会隐藏
自己，其集会场所、教义、目的等都会公开。
不过，这些社团特有的「仪式」还是保密的。
例如「共济会」和「蔷薇十字团」等就是这样。

稍有变化的要数美国某大学的「骷骸会」，
这个秘密结社是为了给成员们提供方便，
使他们能在经济上或社会上取得成功。
这样的话，就需要成员之间非常团结。
所以在入会的时候，每个人都要说出自己
过去的羞耻之事，令其成为成员们所共有
的秘密。这究竟是些怎样的秘密，外人不得
而知。但现在已逐渐明确的是，有几位参加
过总统竞选的候选人也是这个会的成员。

顺带提一下，对于「秘密结社」这个词，
很多人都会感觉带有几分神秘色彩和
魔术般的魅力吧。不过既然称为结社，
那么把加入的仪式称为「入社式」也不无
道理。如此说来，被蔷薇和十字架的神秘
面纱层层遮掩起来的秘密结社，突然感觉
有点像满大街遍布着的中小企业了。
definitions.1.text:
A secret society is a social group formed voluntarily through secret rites rather than ties of blood. In Europe and America, many such societies once centred on social salons and exerted a profound influence on revolutionary movements. Broadly speaking, they can be divided into political secret societies and fraternal secret societies.

Political secret societies conceal their members’ identities and their activities, usually in order to oppose existing political powers or to organise conspiracies. Examples include the Carbonari in Italy and France, the Ku Klux Klan in the United States, and the Bolsheviks in Russia.

Fraternal secret societies, by contrast, do not generally hide their existence. Their meeting places, teachings and aims are made public. Their distinctive rituals, however, remain secret. Freemasonry and the Rosicrucians are examples of this type.

A somewhat different example is Skull and Bones, a secret society at an American university. It exists to help its members achieve economic and social success. This requires a strong bond between them. Upon joining, each member must reveal something shameful from their past, making it a secret shared by the entire society. Outsiders have no way of knowing what these secrets might be. What has gradually become clear, however, is that several people who have run for president have belonged to the society.

The words ‘secret society’ may suggest mystery and an almost magical allure. Yet if it is a society, there is nothing unreasonable about calling its initiation a joining ceremony. Put that way, these societies, so carefully shrouded in the mystery of roses and crosses, suddenly seem rather like the small and medium-sized companies found on every street.

definitions.2.text:
The United States National Security Agency, founded in 1952.

In 1960, two men working at NSA headquarters defected to the Soviet Union, bringing the agency’s existence to light. They fled out of fear of severe discrimination over their homosexuality; American society’s hostility towards homosexuality at the time was extraordinarily harsh. After the incident, the US government investigated NSA personnel with the same sexual orientation and dismissed them.

In the wake of the Watergate scandal of the 1970s, the US Senate’s Church Committee conducted a detailed investigation into abuses by intelligence agencies and published its findings. This made the NSA widely known to the American public. It would be no exaggeration to describe its mission as using ECHELON to intercept every kind of information of intelligence value. The report exposed Project MINARET, under which American citizens involved in the civil rights and anti-Vietnam War movements, including actress Jane Fonda, were subjected to continuous wiretapping and other surveillance. Investigating American citizens without a warrant was prohibited by the US Constitution. Once exposed, the programme drew criticism from the press, the public and Congress.

With the end of the Cold War and the disappearance of its chief enemy, the Soviet Union, the NSA, like other intelligence agencies, began searching for a new reason to exist after 1990. The ‘war on terrorism’ therefore offered it an ideal cause. Following that line of thought, might the NSA encourage terrorism in order to preserve its own existence? Such speculation could conceivably become an urban legend.

definitions.3.source:
梯队系统，是以美国国家安全局（ＮＳＡ）
为核心的国际窃听网络的代号。

探寻通讯窃听系统的起源，
可以追溯到第二次世界大战期间。
当时，英国和美国对轴心国集团设立的
通讯窃听机构，在战后冷战时期进行了
重新编制，组成了以英语圈国家为中心，
对通讯和信号进行窃听、监视，捕捉各
国军事及其它动态的谍报机构。
这就是所谓UKUＳＡ的秘密协定。

除美国之外，英国、加拿大、澳大利?、
新西兰这四个英语圈国家组成梯队系统
的第二集团。事实上，这五个国家被认定
为梯队系统的正式成员。

一般认为，梯队系统的主要窃听对象，
是使用国际通信卫星传递的卫星通讯信息。
这一监听网络可以说是覆盖全球，但也出现了
一个矛盾，那就是英美两国法律都规定不得对
本国公民进行窃听。依照先前提到的UKUＳＡ
协定，英美两国通过相互侦察和情报共享这种
「钻法律漏洞」的手段解决了这个问题。

梯队系统原本是为了在冷战时期监视东方，
但现在用于反恐怖主义，同时还运用于经济
战略方面的目的。
它的首次曝光是在１９９7年１２月英国伦敦的
电讯杂志上，被欧洲共同体正式确认其存在。
据说日本的三泽美军基地也有梯队系统的
设施，负责收集前苏联的情报。但是，对日本
的相关监听是由设在新西兰的设施来完成
的，这是为了从海底电缆中窃取情报。另外，
在２００4年有日本国内媒体报道称，日本将
被允许加入梯队系统，这个消息未经证实。
有观点认为这是日本支援伊拉克战争获得
的回报。
definitions.3.text:
ECHELON is the codename for an international interception network centred on the United States National Security Agency (NSA).

The origins of communications interception systems can be traced back to the Second World War. British and American organisations established to intercept Axis communications were reorganised during the post-war Cold War. They became an intelligence network centred on English-speaking countries, intercepting and monitoring communications and signals to track military and other developments around the world. This was the secret arrangement known as the UKUSA Agreement.

Alongside the United States, four English-speaking countries—Britain, Canada, Australia and New Zealand—form ECHELON’s second group. These five countries are regarded as its full members.

ECHELON is generally believed to target communications transmitted through international communications satellites. Its interception network can be said to cover the globe. This creates a contradiction, however: both British and American law prohibit spying on their own citizens. Under the UKUSA Agreement, the two countries address this by spying on one another and sharing the resulting intelligence, thus exploiting a legal loophole.

Originally intended to monitor the Eastern bloc during the Cold War, ECHELON is now used against terrorism and for purposes of economic strategy. It was first exposed in December 1997 in a London telecommunications magazine, and its existence was formally acknowledged by the European Community. There are said to be ECHELON facilities at the US military base in Misawa, Japan, responsible for gathering intelligence on the former Soviet Union. Monitoring of Japan itself, however, is carried out by facilities in New Zealand, in order to intercept information from submarine cables. In 2004, Japanese media reported that Japan would be allowed to join ECHELON. The report was unconfirmed. Some saw it as a reward for Japan’s support for the Iraq War.

page.3:60660.b3a22eb7.source: [{"text":"大概是由于我没有爽快地给他们答复吧，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"获得主妇们好评的神有些不高兴地问道。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: My failure to give a prompt reply must have annoyed him. The housewives' favourite god was sounding a little put out.

page.3:60780.9f3dcdac.source: [{"text":"「没问题。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"我只是突然想到，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"各位老师都有过初恋的经验吧？」","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: “No problem. Something just occurred to me. Gentlemen, you've all been in love for the first time, haven't you?”

page.3:60896.2db06cdc.source:
[{"text":"面对我这突如其来的提问，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"也许他们是不知所措，又或是置若罔闻，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"一时之间竟陷入冷场。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: Perhaps the unexpected question had thrown them, or perhaps they simply chose to ignore it. Either way, an awkward silence settled over the room.

page.3:61028.a9ad007c.source: [{"text":"「只能埋藏在自己心底的初恋」","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: “That first love you keep buried deep inside.”

page.3:61092.32b3da41.source: [{"text":"「如果连这都要被监视的话，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"会是怎样的心情呢？」","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: “How would you feel if even that were under surveillance?”

page.3:61188.e64162e1.source:
[{"text":"这不是我对诸神们的提问。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"而是对我与这群家伙终归是同类","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"这一无法逃避的事实所发出的自嘲。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: It wasn't a question for the gods. It was a bitter little joke at my own expense—and at the inescapable fact that, in the end, I was one of them.

page.3:61336.859c5ad9.source: [{"text":"「这件事是从朋友的朋友那里听来的……」","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: “I heard this from a friend of a friend…”

","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"也许会触发隐藏的新事件……。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: You won't find every entry in a single investigation. And once you've collected enough of them, a new, hidden incident may come to light…

page.4:62400.1becffee.source:
[{"text":"「……你是怎么知道我名字的？」","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"不容轻视的诸神发起意想不到的反击，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"令我脑海中问号不断。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text:
“...How do you know my name?”
These gods were not to be underestimated. Their unexpected counterattack left my mind full of questions.

page.4:62584.e7074fbd.source: [{"text":"「也未必永远让你做监视方面的事活」","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"昂然自得的一个神发言。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text:
“You may not be doing surveillance work forever.”
One of the gods spoke with an air of smug satisfaction.

page.4:62720.febdbd62.source: [{"text":"……奇怪，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"这个连候补都不算的家伙","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"是怎么进来的？","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: ...Strange. How had this man got in? He was not even a candidate.

page.4:62828.9af09429.source: [{"text":"「道明寺君，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"这位是通过特殊途径","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"紧急应邀出席的」","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: “Domyoji, this gentleman was invited at short notice through a special channel.”

page.4:62936.916c9912.source: [{"text":"在这黑暗的神之领域中，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"唯一一个我认识的男人终于开口了。","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: At last, the only man I knew in this dark realm of the gods spoke.
“What is going on, Director Kazami?”

page.4:63080.c5dfff13.source:
[{"text":"「情况有变。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"对于特殊途径来的就应该给予特殊的款待。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"怎么样？　你把那件事说出来吧……」","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: “Things have changed. A guest who comes through a special channel deserves special treatment. Well? Why not tell him about that matter...”

page.4:63244.c0d633fe.source:
[{"text":"「……了解。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"既然如此那我就公布出来了。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"这就叫监视方面的实力———」","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: “...Understood. In that case, I will lay it all out. This is what surveillance can do—”

page.4:63376.b99ab19a.source: [{"text":"「这是从朋友的朋友那里听来的……」","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: “I heard this from a friend of a friend...”
Have you heard of Kokuan-ten and Kisshoten?

page.10101:63984.ddf8b8ad.source: [{"text":"也就是传说中的『穷神和福神』，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"这么说你该知道了吧。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: The goddess of poverty and the goddess of good fortune, as they are commonly known. Perhaps that sounds more familiar.

page.10101:64088.33b6f27e.source:
[{"text":"佛经『","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"大般","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"涅磐","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"经","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"』","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"和","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"无住","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"道晓","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"的","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"『","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"杂谈集","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"』","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"中，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"记载了这样一条真理：","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: The Buddhist Mahaparinirvana Sutra and Muju Dogyo’s Zodanshu offer this truth:

page.10101:64372.20b5dd27.source: [{"text":"『高兴的时候得意洋洋，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"难过的时候不必绝望』","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: “Let joy lift your spirits, but do not despair in sorrow.”

page.10101:64460.4e17c5c1.source:
[{"text":"『为何这么说呢？ 因为带来幸福的","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"吉祥天和招致不幸的黑暗天是姐妹，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"她们总会一同出现』。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: “Why? Because Kisshoten, who brings happiness, and Kokuan-ten, who brings misfortune, are sisters. They always arrive together.”

page.10101:64608.c112742f.source:
[{"text":"意即，幸福与不幸，不论哪个都不是单独","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"存在的，它们常常是互为表里的一体。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"人生就是在吉凶祸福的平衡下构成的。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: In other words, neither happiness nor misfortune exists alone. They are often two sides of the same thing. Life is built upon a balance of good fortune and bad.

page.10101:64780.b809da71.source:
[{"text":"如果发生坏事，肯定也会有好事。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"人总不会一辈子倒霉的。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"……真的是这样吗？","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text:
If something bad happens, something good is sure to follow. No one can be unlucky all their life.
...Can they?

page.10101:64932.67f56051.source: [{"text":"一方面，有的人一生都被幸福包围着，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"而另一方面，也有人终生不幸吧？","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: Some people spend their whole lives surrounded by happiness. Surely there are others who know nothing but misfortune?

page.10101:65068.38b2de64.source: [{"text":"所有人平等地分享幸福，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"这种事简直无法想象。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: I cannot imagine happiness being shared equally among everyone.

page.10101:65164.51745a75.source: [{"text":"有的人一面做着不道德、不人道的事，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"一面却过着逍遥自在的安逸生活。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: Some people do things that are immoral, even inhuman, yet live comfortable lives without a care in the world.

page.10101:65268.ae196b18.source: [{"text":"有的人虽然老实、认真地过着日子，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"却在","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"贫困线下痛苦挣扎，厄运连连。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: Others live honestly and earnestly, only to struggle in poverty, with one misfortune after another.
There is no equality in this world.

page.10101:65428.6c8f3e86.source: [{"text":"不过，这或许也可以说成是","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"神创造出来的一种平衡吧……","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: Though perhaps that, too, could be called a kind of balance created by the gods...

","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"成排的不锈钢书架","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"紧靠着混凝土墙壁摆放着。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0}]

","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"厚厚的灰色档案。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"简直和墓地没什么两样，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"有这样的感觉也是必然。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0}]

This was where they gathered—
the unofficial case files.

page.10201:68584.c636b337.source:
[{"text":"警察虽然也会把这些案件记录分类，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"

","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: The police sorted and filed these reports, but never treated them as official cases. They were passed from department to department... until they reached my office, the Police History Compilation Office, five floors underground.

page.10201:68964.5bba22fa.source: [{"text":"翻开手边的档案，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"里面汇集了各种怪异的笔录。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: I opened a file beside me. It was a collection of statements about all manner of strange events.

page.10201:69108.af58ae85.source: [{"text":"例如，在午夜的高速公路上，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"被无头骑手超车的暴走族口供。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: For example, the statement of a biker overtaken by a headless rider on a motorway at midnight.

page.10201:69284.bb16ba53.source:
[{"text":"或是长途车司机说的，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"看不见脸的老太婆以惊人的速度","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"超过了自己的卡车。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: Or a long-haul driver’s account of an old woman whose face he could not see, overtaking his truck at an incredible speed.

page.10201:69448.29611665.source: [{"text":"接到报案的派出所，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"不得不对上述事例进行记录。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: The officers at the local police stations had little choice but to record such reports.

page.10201:69548.60549fcc.source: [{"text":"不过，即使记录下来也没人相信，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"所以也不会去调查取证。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: But even when they were written down, no one believed them. No investigation, no search for evidence followed.

page.10201:69656.880ea0f.source: [{"text":"只能被警察们当作上夜班时的谈资，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"然后转来转去就到了编纂室。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: They became something for officers to talk about on the night shift, before being passed around until they reached our office.

page.10201:69920.894d23df.source: [{"text":"可是……我不知道那是否真的就是","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"「不存在的事」。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: And yet... I did not know whether these things really were impossible.

page.10201:70020.50cdf397.source:
[{"text":"做笔录的警察们只是","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"依据各自的常识，把那些事件","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"看作是「不存在的事」。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: The officers who took the statements judged them impossible solely on the basis of their own common sense.

page.10201:70160.d1a2d3d0.source: [{"text":"说不定那个无头骑手，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"是个戴着黑色头盔的人在驾车飞速行驶。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: Perhaps the headless rider was simply someone in a black helmet, speeding down the road.

page.10201:70272.f522c8a7.source: [{"text":"以惊人速度奔跑的老太婆，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"也许是被车碾轧后缠在车身上的受害者。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"\n","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: Perhaps the old woman running at an incredible speed was a victim who had been run over and caught on a vehicle.

page.10201:70388.ab1b038e.source:
[{"text":"对上述事件的各种可能性一一进行确认，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"将数目庞大的档案进行适当地分类和整理，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"这就是我们编纂室的工作。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0}]

parts.text: Our job in the Compilation Office was to examine each possible explanation for these incidents, then sort and organise the enormous collection of files accordingly.

page.10201:70552.64a44145.source:
[{"text":"只不过，就算我对工作内容加以说明，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"还是没人相信。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"即便如此，","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"我依然为能从事这项工作","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"而感到自豪。","color":0,"size":0},{"text":"
","color":0,"size":0}]
